newsitem.title: USA: Kestrel raises $5 mln in offshore placement.
newsitem.headline: Kestrel raises $5 mln in offshore placement.

text.p: Kestrel Energy Inc said Monday it completed a $5 million offshore placement of its common stock, selling 2.5 million shares at $2 each. Kestrel said the the net proceeds were $4.7 million.
The company said the money will be used to develop 9,000 acres of oil leases in the San Joaquin Basin of California, in which it has a 50 percent interest.
Kestrel is an oil and gas exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, with producing properties in California, Kansas, Louisiana, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Texas and Wyoming.
